high_level_description: The image is a meme that features a photograph of Buzz Aldrin, the second man to step on the moon during the Apollo 11 mission. The photo shows him in his spacesuit, holding an astronaut helmet, with the moon prominently displayed in the background. The text overlay on the image reads: "I'M BUZZ ALDRIN, SECOND MAN TO STEP ON THE MOON" "NEIL BEFORE ME" This text is a play on words, referencing the famous quote "One small step for man, one giant leap for mankind," which was spoken by Neil Armstrong when he became the first person to walk on the moon.
